what: Instead of the system cursor, a 6px dot sticks right to the cursor position, and a 36px ring (1px line, .7 opacity) trails behind by 1 − .84^(elapsed/16.7ms) each frame. Over links and buttons the ring grows to 52px at .45 opacity over .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) and the dot shrinks to 4px. While pressed, the ring is .82×, and over input fields it becomes a 2×22px vertical bar. Over anything with data-cursor-label, the ring stretches into a 30px-tall pill (text width + 24px) holding that text, which turns on .14s later

options.lag: Share the ring leaves behind per frame (16.7ms), default .84 — smaller sticks faster
options.hover: Selector for targets the ring grows on, default a, button, [role=button], label, select, summary, [data-cursor=hover]

use: (Ring, dot and text are created if missing. For the pill label, put data-cursor-label on the target="Open")
note: On touch devices (no hover) it does not attach and does not hide the system cursor. For non-DOM targets like a 3D scene, fire an fx:cursor event on the element (detail: { hot, label }fires ) to switch it on

from.where: shared.js .kc-root (all pages) — original kc-ring 1 − .84^(dt/16.667)·36→52px .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)·is-down .82·is-label pill (text width + 24)·is-text 2×22 bar
